text: Explore /home/mi/vela_competition for BK7258/OpenVela WiFi AP network driver and lwIP/NuttX integration behind logs `bk7258_wifi: AP RX/TX`, `CIF: OpenVela TX`, station add/delete. Thoroughness: very thorough. Diagnose from code why a SoftAP client can get DHCP IP yet cannot reach the device HTTP server, and why reconnects may fail. Check Ethernet frame ownership, vif/station mapping, netdev interface/address, ARP, RX input, TX peer selection, and station cleanup. Report paths/lines and concrete minimal fix recommendations. Research only; do not edit.
